cal_group.desc: Optional calibration group label used to group HRUs during calibration; 'null' when unused.

plnt_com.label: Plant Community
plnt_com.desc: Reference to a plant community initialization record (plant.ini); 'null' if none.

mgt.label: Management Schedule
mgt.desc: Reference to a management schedule (management.sch); 'null' if none.

cn2.label: Curve Number
cn2.desc: Reference to a curve number table record (cntable.lum); 'null' if none.

cons_prac.label: Conservation Practices
cons_prac.desc: Reference to a conservation practice record (cons_practice.lum); 'null' if none.

urban.label: Urban Land Use
urban.desc: Reference to an urban land-use record (urban.urb); 'null' if none.

urb_ro.label: Urban Runoff
urb_ro.desc: Urban runoff calculation method for this land use; empty/'null' when not urban.

ov_mann.label: Overland Flow Manning's n
ov_mann.desc: Reference to an overland-flow Manning's n table record (ovn_table.lum); 'null' if none.

tile.label: Tile Drain
tile.desc: Reference to a tile drain structural record (tiledrain.str); 'null' if none.

sep.label: Septic Tank
sep.desc: Reference to a septic tank structural record (septic.str); 'null' if none.

vfs.label: Filter Strip
vfs.desc: Reference to a vegetative filter strip structural record (filterstrip.str); 'null' if none.

grww.label: Grassed Waterway
grww.desc: Reference to a grassed waterway structural record (grassedww.str); 'null' if none.

bmp.label: Best Management Practices
bmp.desc: Reference to a user best-management-practice structural record (bmpuser.str); 'null' if none.

name.label: Name
name.desc: Unique curve number table record name (record key).

cn_a.label: Curve Number - Soil Group A
cn_a.desc: SCS runoff curve number for hydrologic soil group A (moisture condition II). Dimensionless, 0-100.

cn_b.label: Curve Number - Soil Group B
cn_b.desc: SCS runoff curve number for hydrologic soil group B (moisture condition II). Dimensionless, 0-100.

cn_c.label: Curve Number - Soil Group C
cn_c.desc: SCS runoff curve number for hydrologic soil group C (moisture condition II). Dimensionless, 0-100.

cn_d.label: Curve Number - Soil Group D
cn_d.desc: SCS runoff curve number for hydrologic soil group D (moisture condition II). Dimensionless, 0-100.

description.label: Description
description.desc: Free-text description of the land cover (e.g. Fallow, Row_crops).

treat.label: Treatment
treat.desc: Free-text treatment/practice descriptor (e.g. Bare_soil, Crop_residue_cover, Straight_row).

cond_cov.label: Hydrologic Condition
cond_cov.desc: Free-text hydrologic condition / cover quality descriptor (e.g. Poor, Good, ----).

name.label: Name
name.desc: Unique conservation practice record name (record key).

usle_p.label: USLE Support Practice Factor (P)
usle_p.desc: USLE support/conservation practice factor P; dimensionless, typically 0-1 (1 = no practice).

slp_len_max.label: Maximum Slope Length
slp_len_max.desc: Maximum USLE slope length for the practice, in meters.

description.label: Description
description.desc: Free-text description of the conservation practice (e.g. Cross_slope_tillage).

name.label: Name
name.desc: Unique overland-flow Manning's n table record name (record key).

ovn_mean.label: Mean Manning's n
ovn_mean.desc: Mean Manning's roughness coefficient (n) for overland flow. Dimensionless.

ovn_min.label: Minimum Manning's n
ovn_min.desc: Minimum Manning's roughness coefficient (n) for overland flow. Dimensionless.

ovn_max.label: Maximum Manning's n
ovn_max.desc: Maximum Manning's roughness coefficient (n) for overland flow. Dimensionless.

description.label: Description
description.desc: Free-text description of the surface cover / tillage condition (e.g. Conventional_tillage_residue).

name.label: Schedule Name
name.desc: Unique management schedule name (record key). Must be unique.

numb_ops.label: Number of Operations
numb_ops.desc: Count of manual operation rows that follow for this schedule.

numb_auto.label: Number of Automatic Operations
numb_auto.desc: Count of automatic decision-table (auto) operations attached to this schedule.

op_typ.label: Operation
op_typ.desc: Operation type code for a manual operation row.

mon.label: Month
mon.desc: Month the operation occurs; 0 means none (use heat units instead).

day.label: Day
day.desc: Day of month the operation occurs (1-31); 0 means none (use heat units instead).

hu_sch.label: Heat Units Fraction
hu_sch.desc: Fraction of potential heat units at which to schedule the operation (0-1); used when month/day are 0.

op_data1.label: Operation Data 1
op_data1.desc: Primary reference name for the operation; meaning depends on op_typ (plant name for plnt/harv/kill/hvkl, tillage name for till, irrigation op for irrm, fertilizer name for fert, pesticide name for pest, graze op for graz).

op_data2.label: Operation Data 2
op_data2.desc: Secondary reference name for the operation; used for harv/hvkl (harvest operation name) and fert/pest (chemical application name); 'null' otherwise.

op_data3.label: Operation Data 3
op_data3.desc: Numeric override value; meaning depends on op_typ (amount applied kg/ha for fert/pest, number of grazing days for graz, tile depth for dwm); 0 when unused.

name.label: Name
name.desc: Weather station name; must be unique.

wgn.label: Weather Generator
wgn.desc: Weather generator assigned to this station; references a station name in weather-wgn.cli.

pcp.label: Precipitation
pcp.desc: Observed precipitation file name (.pcp), or 'sim' to use the weather generator.

tmp.label: Temperature
tmp.desc: Observed temperature file name (.tem/.tmp), or 'sim' to use the weather generator.

slr.label: Solar Radiation
slr.desc: Observed solar radiation file name (.slr), or 'sim' to use the weather generator.

hmd.label: Relative Humidity
hmd.desc: Observed relative humidity file name (.hmd), or 'sim' to use the weather generator.

wnd.label: Wind Speed
wnd.desc: Observed wind speed file name (.wnd), or 'sim' to use the weather generator.

pet.label: Potential Evapotranspiration
pet.desc: Observed potential evapotranspiration file name, or 'null' if not used (no simulated option).

atmo_dep.label: Atmospheric Deposition
atmo_dep.desc: Atmospheric deposition station name (references atmo.cli / atmo_sta), or 'null' if not used.

filename.label: File Name
filename.desc: Name of an observed precipitation (.pcp) data file listed for the project; one row per file.

filename.label: File Name
filename.desc: Name of an observed temperature (.tem/.tmp) data file listed for the project; one row per file.

name.label: Name
name.desc: Soil name; record key, must be unique.

nly.label: Number of Layers
nly.desc: Number of soil layers in the profile (derived from the layers sub-table, not directly edited).

dp_tot.label: Maximum Rooting Depth of Soil Profile
dp_tot.desc: Maximum rooting depth of soil profile.

anion_excl.label: Anion Exclusion Fraction
anion_excl.desc: Fraction of porosity (void space) from which anions are excluded (no unit suffix in the editor).

perc_crk.label: Crack Volume Fraction
perc_crk.desc: Potential or maximum crack volume of the soil profile expressed as a fraction of the total soil volume (no unit suffix in the editor).

texture.label: Texture
texture.desc: Texture label of the soil (optional, free text).

awc.label: Available Water Capacity
awc.desc: Available water capacity of soil layer.

soil_k.label: Saturated Hydraulic Conductivity
soil_k.desc: Saturated hydraulic conductivity of soil layer.

alb.label: Moist Soil Albedo
alb.desc: Soil albedo when soil is moist (0–0.25).

name.label: Name
name.desc: Project/simulation name; record key.

gwfl.label: gwflow / MODFLOW Cells
gwfl.desc: Number of gwflow (MODFLOW) cell objects (internal field mfl).
